name: SenseNova-Loop-9B model card
notes: Vendor model card, read in full 2026-11-23 (17,775 bytes of README, 3,679 bytes of config.json). HF API createdAt 2026-11-17T10:16:41Z, matching the card's own '2026-11-17: We release SenseNova-Loop-9B' news line; a Preview was released 2026-10-31. safetensors.total 9,656,254,576 (9,653,102,832 BF16 + 3,151,744 F32); sibling file sizes sum to ~19.4 GB, consistent with BF16 for 9.66B params. Architecture from config.json: model_type sensenova_loop wrapping a text_config of model_type qwen3_5_text, 32 hidden layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, 16 attention heads / 4 KV heads / head_dim 256, vocab 248,320, max_position_embeddings 524288, layer_types alternating 3 linear_attention + 1 full_attention, loop_settings {start 4, end 28, counts [2]}, mhc {streams 2, iterations 20}. Card prose claims 512K context and 'approximately 9B total parameters; approximately 14.6B inference-equivalent parameters'; the 14.6B is a compute figure, not weights. Benchmark numbers appear ONLY in prose and in assets/release_benchmark_iuua.png - there is no markdown benchmark table and no harness/scaffold statement, so every score from this source is a vendor claim at an undocumented configuration. Deployment table (4-bit weights ~4.9 GB; ~10/12/15 GiB total at 64K/128K/256K with 8-bit KV) was used to cross-check the derived KV cache figure. Official AWQ and GGUF (BF16/Q8_0/Q5_K_M/Q4_K_M) repos are linked from the card. Also linked: GitHub OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Loop, ModelScope mirror, a Preview repo, and deployment recipes for LightLLM, SGLang and vLLM.
